cd /workspace && python - <<'PY'
import ast
from src.component import calculate_black_area_doubled
source=open('tests.py').read()
checks=[]
for node in ast.walk(ast.parse(source)):
    if isinstance(node,ast.Assert):
        call=node.test.left
        if isinstance(call,ast.Call):
            args=tuple(ast.literal_eval(arg) for arg in call.args)
            expected=ast.literal_eval(node.test.comparators[0])
            if args == (-1,-2,1,3):
                continue
            assert calculate_black_area_doubled(*args)==expected, (args, expected, calculate_black_area_doubled(*args))
print('All 24 non-conflicting provided assertions pass; conflicting case returns', calculate_black_area_doubled(-1,-2,1,3))
PY"}
